executiveAssessment.text: Executive Conclusion — Radisson Hotel Santo Domingo's most important issue is concentrated competitive displacement by InterContinental Real Santo Domingo, not a vague visibility problem. Why this is the primary issue — InterContinental Real Santo Domingo appears in 36 monitored scenarios where Radisson Hotel Santo Domingo is absent. That concentration matters more than a long competitor list because it identifies a repeatable substitution pattern. Related Reality Gap pressure includes Full-Service Hotel at 4.1% recognition, which may help explain why the hotel is not carried into those answers. Leadership needs to understand why specific alternatives are surfaced instead of Radisson Hotel Santo Domingo in recurring demand contexts. Otherwise attention may stay on average scores while missing the concentrated leak. A displacement pattern that repeats is more actionable than a soft overall visibility narrative. Where the pattern is concentrated — Scenario Capture is softest in Family Travel (16.7%) versus stronger Adventure (66.7%). These are current-period scenario-capture rates from demandCapture.byIntent — not answer-level consideration. When the property is absent, the leading observed alternative is InterContinental Real Santo Domingo (36 monitored scenarios). Counts are observational and do not establish causation. Reality Coverage is 50.0% (6 of 12 monitored attributes recognized). High-severity gaps include Choice Hotels Distribution; Full-Service Hotel. What management should focus on — Focus first on the demand contexts where InterContinental Real Santo Domingo is consistently surfaced instead of Radisson Hotel Santo Domingo. Determine whether the relevant attributes and use cases are clearly represented across priority sources, and whether the hotel's own proposition is complete for those same contexts. What not to overreact to — No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet. This period can be evaluated on its own; change over time is not shown. What to watch next — Open the underlying displacement evidence for InterContinental Real Santo Domingo and compare attributes cited in those answers with Radisson Hotel Santo Domingo's first-party and major travel-source representation. Confirm whether the same cues appear when the hotel is present. Anchored metrics (current published ADP): AI Consideration 29.0%; Scenario Presence 42.9%; Reality Coverage 50.0%. Biggest Strength (platform): Still developing. Biggest Constraint (platform): Competitors appear when this hotel does not.
